register.labelZh: PLUMP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: plump for 可用來說明你最後選擇哪一款食物、哪一個人、哪種顏色或哪項計劃。；plump down 可以表示重重地坐下;plump something down 則可以表示把物件重重地放下。；plump up 可以描述提子乾、乾果或米粒變得較飽滿柔軟。；plump something up 可用來描述把扁平的枕頭或靠墊拍鬆,令它重新變得飽滿舒適。
register.summaryEn: Plump for helps you say which meal, person, colour or plan you finally choose. Plump down can describe sitting down heavily, while plump something down describes putting an object down heavily. Plump up can describe raisins, dried fruit or rice becoming fuller and softer. Plump something up helps you describe making a flat pillow or cushion look full and comfortable again.
